segments.t: It is early Saturday morning at Courtyard Inn in Chengdu, just hours after Chen carried a dusty cedar box stamped 'Room 9' up from the cellar. Qing and Manager Zhou lean over the front desk as Chen turns the tiny brass key. Listen to the scene first.
老陈，慢慢转那把小钥匙——我的心跳得很快！
放心吧，老板。地下室的铜锁不会坏。
开了！老陈，快打开木头盖子！
里面有……一把大门钥匙、一张蓝色的图，还有明信片。
快看看那张蓝纸上写着什么！我的眼镜呢？
还在您的额头上呢，周经理，跟昨天晚上一样。
啊！看这儿：一楼，九号房，花园阳光房！
等等，我们一楼有一个花园阳光房？
看这个箭头——指着走廊里的书架！
那个大书架靠着那面墙，已经二十年了！
那么，那些旧书后面有第九扇门！
先喝一口咖啡，然后我们搬书。
Now let's go through it line by line with the English translation.
老陈，慢慢转那把小钥匙——我的心跳得很快！
'Turn the little key slowly, Chen—my heart is beating so fast!'
放心吧，老板。地下室的铜锁不会坏。
'Relax, boss. A brass lock from the cellar won't break.'
开了！老陈，快打开木头盖子！
'It's open! Chen, quick, lift the wooden lid!'
里面有……一把大门钥匙、一张蓝色的图，还有明信片。
'Inside there's... one big door key, a blue plan, and postcards.'
快看看那张蓝纸上写着什么！我的眼镜呢？
'Quick, read what it says on that blue paper! Where are my glasses?'
还在您的额头上呢，周经理，跟昨天晚上一样。
'Still on your forehead, Manager Zhou, same as last night.'
啊！看这儿：一楼，九号房，花园阳光房！
'Aha! Look here: ground floor, Room Nine, garden sunroom!'
等等，我们一楼有一个花园阳光房？
'Wait, we have a garden sunroom on the ground floor?'
看这个箭头——指着走廊里的书架！
'Look at this arrow—it points at the bookcase in the hallway!'
那个大书架靠着那面墙，已经二十年了！
'That big bookcase has stood against that wall for twenty years!'
那么，那些旧书后面有第九扇门！
'So behind those old books, there's a ninth door!'
先喝一口咖啡，然后我们搬书。
'First one sip of coffee, then we move the books.'
Now let's listen to the whole conversation one last time.

看这个箭头——指着走廊里的书架！
那个大书架靠着那面墙，已经二十年了！

Inside the cedar box sit a heavy door key and a floor plan pointing straight behind the hallway bookcase. Don't worry if a word or two went past quickly; they return right away. See you next time.
回头见！
